headline: South Korea’s $350 Billion Bet on American Industry
facebook_description: South Korea has committed $350 billion to strategic investment in the United States, including $150 billion for shipbuilding. Its finance minister confirmed a $2.4 billion transfer in October toward a proposed $22.3 billion Texas power project. A nuclear framework could bring up to $120 billion in additional project investment within the broader package. These commitments are not completed facilities or guaranteed jobs. Can the partnership rebuild American industrial capacity? Follow EP News for the latest developments. #SouthKorea #Texas #Energy #Shipbuilding
